 TOI Tech Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Nov 17, 2026, 23:48 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Google and Apple Apple and Google users have complained of running into issues while trying to access core services, including iCloud, the App Store and Wallet as well as Gmail . Google Search with connection errors and sign-in failures reported across multiple platforms. According to outage-tracking site Downdetector, reports of service disruptions began climbing around 11:30 am ET (10:00 pm IST) and surged to nearly 1,500-2,000 within an hour. Users report sign-in failures
 As per Downdetector, iCloud and Apple Pay were the most disrupted services, followed by Gmail, Search and App Store. People reported widespread problems in logging in, messaging, emails, payments and fund transfers. Join conversation
 View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments

 Users took to X to document the problems they were encountering. While some said “Apple pay not working”, others reported issues with Apple iCloud / Apple Account Verification sign in. The Apple and Google service issues add to a rough stretch of digital outages over the past week. Earlier this week, banking customers ran into online access problems and transaction delays after a technical glitch hit JPMorgan Chase and spilled over to other banks. Those disruptions followed a major Microsoft outage last week that knocked Outlook email services offline. Developing story...
